title: Synthetic Clinical Notes for Rare ICD Codes: A Data-Centric Framework for Long-Tail Medical Coding
abstract: arXiv:2511.14112v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Automatic ICD coding from clinical text is a critical task in medical NLP but remains hindered by the extreme long-tail distribution of diagnostic codes. Thousands of rare and zero-shot ICD codes are severely underrepresented in datasets like MIMIC-III, leading to low macro-F1 scores. In this work, we propose a data-centric framework that generates high-quality synthetic discharge summaries to mitigate this imbalance. Our method constructs realistic multi-label code sets anchored on rare codes by leveraging real-world co-occurrence patterns, ICD descriptions, synonyms, taxonomy, and similar clinical notes. Using these structured prompts, we generate 90,000 synthetic notes covering 7,902 ICD codes, significantly expanding the training distribution. translated_title: 面向罕见ICD编码的合成临床笔记：一种以数据为中心的长尾医疗编码框架
translated_abstract: 从临床文本中自动进行ICD编码是医学自然语言处理中的一项关键任务，但诊断编码的极端长尾分布仍然阻碍着该任务的发展。数千个罕见和零样本的ICD编码在MIMIC-III等数据集中严重欠表示，导致宏观F1分数较低。在本工作中，我们提出了一个以数据为中心的框架，通过生成高质量的合成出院摘要来缓解这种不平衡。我们的方法利用真实世界的共现模式、ICD描述、同义词、分类体系以及相似的临床笔记，构建以罕见编码为锚点的真实多标签编码集合。利用这些结构化提示，我们生成了90,000份覆盖7,902个ICD编码的合成笔记，显著扩展了训练数据的分布。我们在原始数据集和扩展数据集上微调了两个最先进的基于Transformer的模型PLM-ICD和GKI-ICD。实验表明，我们的方法适度提升了宏观F1分数。
tldr: 该论文提出一个以数据为中心的合成数据生成框架，利用真实共现模式和ICD知识生成9万份覆盖7902个ICD编码的合成出院摘要，以缓解ICD编码长尾分布不平衡问题并提升罕见编码的自动编码性能。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a data-centric framework that generates 90,000 synthetic discharge summaries covering 7,902 ICD codes by leveraging real-world co-occurrence patterns and ICD knowledge, mitigating the long-tail imbalance in automatic ICD coding and improving performance on rare codes.
